patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — ActiveCampaign documents a broader use-case set; Flodesk is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose ActiveCampaign only if your buying job matches “Email marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys; CRM pipelines strongest on Plus+;” rather than Flodesk's shape. Choose Flodesk only if your buying job matches “Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everythin” rather than ActiveCampaign's shape. Workflow advantage: ActiveCampaign leans lead-management, inbound-sales; Flodesk leans small-business-campaigns. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — ActiveCampaign documents a broader use-case set; Flodesk is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: ActiveCampaign is Email marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys; CRM pipelines strongest on Plus+; contact-based pricing.; Flodesk is Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everything plans..
- Company-size focus: ActiveCampaign (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Flodesk (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: ActiveCampaign-leaning lead-management, inbound-sales, high-volume-lead-management vs Flodesk-leaning small-business-campaigns.
- Researched limits: ActiveCampaign — Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.; Flodesk — Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier.

Limitations — ActiveCampaign: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.; Flodesk: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier; Subscriber-tier pricing replaced legacy flat unlimited for new members.

Poor-fit cases: ActiveCampaign is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change. · Flodesk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier · Avoid ActiveCampaign if you actually need Flodesk's motion (Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro /)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
